from typing import Annotated
from cyclopts import App, Bounds

app = App()

@app.command
def serve(port: Annotated[int, Bounds(1024, 65535)]) -> None:
    """Start server on the specified port."""
    print(f"Server running on port {port}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    app()
